page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a baseline clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio establishes a compute-dense profile, prioritizing raw processing capacity over memory volume. This resource distribution is designed for workloads that require consistent CPU execution without the overhead of unutilized memory.
Appropriate workloads for the ecs.c9i.4xlarge include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive application servers.
